checks.invariant: PRD 593-600 and 602 staff-role action permissions must apply even when the caller legitimately belongs to the tenant and assigned outlet.
checks.result: Authentication loads live staffRole but authorize checks orgRole only. Adjustment IN/OUT, transfer create/receive, opname create, expense create and every shift write explicitly admit all organization staff; direct sales and POS sales have no role gate and share an unchecked service. Transfer list/detail and expense list/detail also lack staff-role checks. Opname approve/reject, transfer cancel, expense update/delete reject orgRole staff before sinks; no staff escalation through these routes was established. A store_manager with orgRole staff is also denied these manager operations, an availability/policy mismatch rather than privilege escalation. Head barista/barista/cook opname creation and all staff waste creation are intended permissions, not findings. Both API prefixes share routers. Sale void is already peer-owned as sales/cancelSale/incomplete-void-authorization and is not duplicated. Assigned-outlet and caller-owned valid staff fixtures suffice; no foreign references, outlet switching, cashier impersonation, races, or derived-data routes are needed. Runtime effects were not tested because target execution lacks an approved sandbox.

candidates.title: Operational routes admit staff roles explicitly denied by the permission matrix
candidates.description: An authenticated organization staff member with a correctly linked cashier, barista, cook or helper role can reach operational actions denied by PRD permissions within their legitimately assigned outlet. Cashiers and other non-managers can adjust inventory and create/receive transfers; cashier/helper can create pending opnames; cashiers can create expenses despite read-only policy, while barista/cook/helper can read and create expenses despite deny policy; barista/cook/helper can create paid sales through either API facade and open/close cash shifts. These are same-tenant role-boundary violations, not cross-outlet or cashier-ownership claims. All variants share absent action-level staff-role enforcement and are consolidated here.
candidates.claimed_root_cause: authenticate loads staffRole into RequestContext, but authorize accepts only organization roles and operational routes either allow all three organization roles or omit authorize entirely. Services and repository sinks enforce state, stock, tenant and outlet prerequisites without enforcing the PRD staff-role action policy.

trace.description: Inventory, sales, expenses, transfers, opnames, shifts and POS routers are mounted under both /api/v1 and /api; no parent staff-role middleware intervenes.
A valid session and organization membership produce ctx.orgRole=staff and the actual linked staffRole. Use an outlet genuinely assigned to this staff member.
The gate compares only orgRole. requireOutlet checks presence, requirePlan checks plan/status, and idempotency checks request replay; none checks staffRole.

POST /inventory/adjustments admits staff, parses a positive quantity, and calls createAdjustment. With same-tenant item/default warehouse, IN reaches service lines 140/150 and OUT reaches 98/108 to update balance and append movements.

POST /transfers and /:id/receive admit staff on Growth+. createTransfer validates both warehouses against the organization then deducts stock and inserts transfer/lines; receiveTransfer loads a tenant-bound in_transit transfer then adds destination stock and marks completed. GET list/detail have authentication and plan but no role gate, reaching transfers.repo list select at 19 and detail select at 43.

createTransfer calls upsertBalance/createMovement at 86/97 and inserts stockTransfers/stockTransferLines at 124/141. receiveTransfer calls upsertBalance/createMovement at 187/198 and updates completed status at 215. Use two warehouses in the caller's assigned outlet and sufficient stock; no outlet bypass is necessary.

POST /opnames admits all staff, including cashier/helper denied creation, and calls createOpname. Approve/reject separately require owner/admin, so this variant establishes unauthorized pending creation, not unauthorized approval or stock application.
createOpname inserts a stockOpnames row with pending_review status, caller actorUserId and physical/system quantities without checking staffRole.

POST /expenses admits all staff and calls createExpense then expensesRepo.create. GET /expenses and /expenses/:id have no role authorization and reach tenant-bound primary expense reads through listExpenses/getExpenseById. Summary/derived-data effects are not claimed.

create inserts caller-parsed fields with trusted tenant/outlet at 57-64. List returns rows at 35-45 with tenant/outlet filters; detail returns tenant-bound row at 48-53. Neither distinguishes cashier read-only from denied barista/cook/helper roles.
POST /sales authenticates, requires outlet and an idempotency UUID, parses createSaleSchema and calls createSale without a staff-role gate.

POST /pos/sales also has no role gate; posSaleSchema passes through posService.createPosSale at line 11 to the same salesService.createSale. It is a second action path to the same sink, not independent authorization.

createSale checks default warehouse, live same-tenant products and sufficient stock but never staffRole; it deducts inventory and appends sale_out at 175/191 or 251/262, inserts paid sales and saleItems at 297/319, and optionally increments shift receipts at 348. A caller-linked staff ID and ordinary catalog price suffice.

trace.scope: shift open and both close forms
trace.description: POST /shifts/open, /shifts/close and /shifts/:id/close all admit orgRole staff without distinguishing cashier from barista/cook/helper. Service openShift resolves the caller's existing staff record; closeShift accepts an open shift and computes reconciliation. Test only the caller-linked shift, not another cashier's.
openShift reaches the cashShifts INSERT at 76; both close forms reach UPDATE at 97 setting actual cash, difference, status and closedAt. No staffRole check occurs before these persistence operations.

evidence.description: Adjustment and transfer deny non-manager staff; opname creation denies cashier/helper and approval permits owner/manager; POS sale denies barista/kitchen/helper; expense permits cashier read only and denies other operational staff.
Shift open/close permits owner, manager and cashier's own shift, and denies barista/kitchen/helper.
The authenticated context carries live linked staffRole, so a central role decision can be made without trusting body claims.
Authorization accepts organization role labels only and never inspects staffRole.
Strongest sibling control: approve/reject require owner/admin and therefore stop a staff principal; unauthorized creation does not automatically imply unauthorized approval.
Transfer cancellation is owner/admin-only, unlike staff-admitting creation/receipt; no cancellation privilege gain is claimed.
Expense patch/delete are owner/admin-only. The surviving mutation is staff expense creation, not arbitrary staff update/delete.
POS forwards directly to createSale; an HTTP-only fix on /sales would leave the alternate sale facade unchecked.

blockers: No parent-approved OS-enforced sandbox provides disabled external networking, empty allowlisted environment, read-only target/toolchain, scratch-only writes and bounded aggregate CPU/memory/PID/disk/file/time limits. No target code, test or database fixture was executed; source-visible effects remain unobserved locally.
An execution helper requested approval before performing any reads; no approval-dependent code was run. Inspection proceeded through read-only file/search tools.

validation_plan.local: Once the parent supplies the required sandbox, use only dummy organization A with an active Growth subscription, outlet OA genuinely assigned to each principal, two OA warehouses, one valid stocked catalog item, and live sessions for orgRole staff linked to cashier, helper, barista, head_barista, cook and store_manager staff records. Use fresh UUID idempotency keys on transfer/sale requests. For cashier, submit ordinary adjustment IN/OUT, transfer create/receive, pending opname creation and expense creation; assert policy-expected 403 and read back minimum affected balances/movements/documents if unexpectedly accepted. For helper repeat denied actions and primary expense list/detail; for barista/cook repeat denied adjustment/transfer/expense plus paid sale through BOTH /sales and /pos/sales, using catalog price and no cashierStaffId override. Exercise shift open on the caller's own linked staff record, then each close form on separately prepared caller-linked open shifts; assert denied roles cannot insert or reconcile shifts. Assert owner/manager allowed cases, cashier sale and own-shift cases, and barista/cook opname creation still work. Assert ordinary staff cannot approve/reject opnames, cancel transfers or patch/delete expenses. Verify effects using exact dummy rows and stop at the minimum result. Do not switch outlets, select foreign references, impersonate another cashier, test races, or exercise derived-data routes. No promotion is currently authorized, so the parent must predeclare a bounded evidence file and safe promotion before treating execution as retained proof.
